'''Suu-Tonn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi instructor|combat instructor]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Suu-Tonn was extremely skilled in all seven [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|forms]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|201|Suu-Tonn}}</ref>
